purpose: Shared current MaterialState binding for scoped owners, bounded to Schedule/Actual material facets.

columns.name: scoped_owner_ref
columns.meaning: Scoped owner address whose current facet is bound.

primary_key.name: pk_scoped_current_material_state
primary_key.reason: At most one current binding per scoped owner and facet.

foreign_keys.name: fk_scoped_current_material_state_owner_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind current control to an existing scoped owner address.

foreign_keys.name: fk_scoped_current_material_state_state_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind current control to one exact material-state address.

unique_constraints.name: uq_scoped_current_material_state_material_state_ref
unique_constraints.reason: One MaterialStateRef cannot be current through two scoped current bindings.

check_constraints.name: ck_scoped_current_material_state_facet_code
check_constraints.reason: Keep scoped current bindings bounded to Schedule/Actual baseline facets.

indexes.name: uq_scoped_current_material_state_material_state_ref
indexes.reason: Unique reverse current binding by MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: trg_scoped_current_material_state_current_binding
triggers.reason: CP6-M05 database-local enforcement for current material state binding.

triggers.name: ctrg_scoped_current_material_state_current_history
triggers.reason: CP6-M05 database-local enforcement for current history equivalence.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Points to the accepted current MaterialStateRef; does not own the payload.
state_history.current_binding: Direct shared control table; later Schedule/Actual current views expose bounded mutation.
state_history.chronology: Currentness history is retained in facet-specific history tables created later.
state_history.immutability_policy: Direct runtime DML remains denied; mutation is later exposed only through bounded views.

obligations: CP6-M02 live topology, constraint, index and ACL proof
